content.title: Modes of presentation and pathways to invasive management and myocardial revascularization in patients presenting with STEMI
content.summary: Flowchart describing presentation modes, first medical contact (FMC) locations, decision points for reperfusion strategy, and time targets for primary PCI vs fibrinolysis.

flow_steps.onset_of_symptoms: Patient with symptoms of ACS and ECG consistent with STEMI.

if_yes.strategy: PPCI strategy via immediate transfer to PCI centre for primary PCI

if_no.strategy: Fibrinolysis strategy with immediate transfer to PCI centre after fibrinolysis

reperfusion_timing_legend.bars_represent: Total ischaemic time and sources of delay to reperfusion

content.notes: Emphasis on minimizing time to reperfusion: immediate transfer for PPCI when feasible within target times; prompt fibrinolysis if timely PCI cannot be achieved, followed by transfer for possible PCI.
